mapper.select: SELECT SMS_GROUP_ID, SMS_GROUP_NAME FROM SMS_RECEIVER_GROUP WHERE ORGAN_ID = #{organ_id} ORDER BY SMS_GROUP_ID
SELECT a.RTU_ID, a.RTU_NAME, b.SMS_IDX FROM RTU_INFO AS a LEFT JOIN SMS_EQUIPMENT AS b ON a.RTU_ID = b.RTU_ID WHERE a.ORGAN_ID = #{organ_id} ORDER BY a.RTU_NAME
SELECT a.RTU_ID, a.RTU_NAME, b.SENSOR_TYPE FROM RTU_INFO AS a LEFT JOIN RTU_SENSOR AS b ON a.RTU_ID = b.RTU_ID WHERE a.ORGAN_ID = #{organ_id} AND b.SENSOR_TYPE IS NOT NULL ORDER BY a.RTU_NAME

SELECT A.IDX, A.USER_NAME, AES_DECRYPT(UNHEX(A.MOBILE), MD5(#{organ_code})) as MOBILE, A.MEMO, A.SMS_GROUP_ID, B.SMS_GROUP_NAME, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SMS_EQUIPMENT WHERE TYPE = '1' AND SMS_IDX = A.IDX AND SMS_SEND_GROUP = '1') AS GROUP1, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SMS_EQUIPMENT WHERE TYPE = '1' AND SMS_IDX = A.IDX AND SMS_SEND_GROUP = '2') AS GROUP2
,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SMS_EQUIPMENT WHERE TYPE = '1' AND SMS_IDX = A.IDX AND SMS_SEND_GROUP = '3') AS GROUP3
,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SMS_EQUIPMENT WHERE TYPE = '1' AND SMS_IDX = A.IDX AND SMS_SEND_GROUP = '3') AS GROUP3
,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SMS_EQUIPMENT WHERE TYPE = '1' AND SMS_IDX = A.IDX AND SMS_SEND_GROUP = '3') AS GROUP3, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SMS_EQUIPMENT WHERE TYPE = '1' AND SMS_IDX = A.IDX AND SMS_SEND_GROUP = '4') AS GROUP4, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SMS_EQUIPMENT WHERE TYPE = '1' AND SMS_IDX = A.IDX AND SMS_SEND_GROUP = '5') AS GROUP5
FROM SMS_RECEIVER A LEFT JOIN SMS_RECEIVER_GROUP B ON A.SMS_GROUP_ID = B.SMS_GROUP_ID WHERE B.ORGAN_ID = #{organ_id}
AND A.USER_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%',#{search_text},'%')
AND B.SMS_GROUP_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%',#{search_text},'%')
AND A.MEMO LIKE CONCAT('%',#{search_text},'%')
AND AES_DECRYPT(UNHEX(A.MOBILE), MD5(#{organ_code})) LIKE CONCAT('%',#{search_text},'%')
AND B.SMS_GROUP_ID = #{sms_group_id}
ORDER BY A.USER_NAME

SELECT MSG_ID, USER_ID, SEND_DATE, CALLBACK, SMS_MSG, SCHEDULE_TYPE, DEST_COUNT FROM SDK_SMS_REPORT WHERE SUBSTR(SEND_DATE,1,8) BETWEEN date_format(#{sdate}, '%Y%m%d') AND date_format(#{edate}, '%Y%m%d') AND RESERVED6 = #{organ_id} AND ( (RESERVED1 IS NULL AND RESERVED3 IS NULL) OR (RESERVED1 = '3' AND RESERVED3 = '1') )
AND DEST_INFO LIKE CONCAT('%',#{dest_info},'%')
AND CALLBACK LIKE CONCAT('%',#{callback},'%')
AND SMS_MSG LIKE CONCAT('%',#{sms_msg},'%')
AND SCHEDULE_TYPE = #{schedule_type}
AND SUCC_COUNT != '0' AND FAIL_COUNT = '0'
AND FAIL_COUNT != '0'
ORDER BY MSG_ID DESC

SELECT a.USER_ID, a.SEND_DATE, a.CALLBACK, a.SCHEDULE_TYPE, b.PHONE_NUMBER, b.RESULT, b.TCS_RESULT FROM SDK_SMS_REPORT AS a LEFT JOIN SDK_SMS_REPORT_DETAIL AS b ON a.MSG_ID = b.MSG_ID WHERE a.MSG_ID = #{msg_id}
SELECT SMS_GROUP_ID, SMS_GROUP_NAME FROM SMS_RECEIVER_GROUP WHERE ORGAN_ID = #{organ_id}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SMS_RECEIVER WHERE MOBILE = HEX(AES_ENCRYPT(#{mobile}, MD5(#{organ_code})))
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO SMS_RECEIVER ( USER_NAME, MOBILE, SMS_GROUP_ID, MEMO, REG_DATE ) VALUES ( #{user_name}, HEX(AES_ENCRYPT(#{mobile}, MD5(#{organ_code}))), #{sms_group_id}, #{memo}, NOW() )
